title: Registry DB mTLS activation smoke and failure evidence package contract

activation_boundary.summary: This is future/operator-gated evidence planning only. It is not proof activation occurred and performs no registry DB mTLS production activation, no real certificate material handling, no private key handling, no provisioning, no production host mutation, no compose/profile activation, and no plaintext fallback.

operator_gate.required_statement: Future registry DB mTLS activation smoke and failure evidence must be operator-gated, timestamped, redacted, reviewer-backed, tied to an explicit change window, and bound to server-side TLS/client-certificate enforcement, approved secret location identifiers, certificate expiry/revocation/hostname metadata, no-plaintext fallback behavior, bounded sanitized failure diagnostics, rollback criteria, and fail-closed criteria before any activation claim can be considered.

readiness_prerequisites.required_statement: Epic 133 DB mTLS readiness and Stories 134.1-134.3 evidence contracts are prerequisites only and are not proof activation occurred.

minimum_evidence: operator approval and change-window references
target environment and version references
registry DB mTLS profile reference without credential values
evidence expiry timestamp and independent reviewer reference
server-side TLS enforcement evidence by reference only
TLS mode or provider policy reference without secret material
failure evidence showing non-TLS database access is rejected
client certificate requirement evidence by reference only
approved client identity or role reference without certificate subject material
failure evidence showing missing or wrong client certificate is rejected
approved secret location identifiers by ticket or inventory reference only
no private key material, certificate material, credential values, or full host paths
separation of CA, client certificate, and private key references
certificate expiry window metadata by redacted reference
revocation status or CRL/OCSP policy reference
hostname verification metadata without production hostname disclosure
plaintext connection attempt rejection evidence
REGISTRY_DB_MTLS_ENABLED disabled/default behavior remains local-safe and not production activation
no fallback to non-mTLS remote Postgres when mTLS evidence is required
bounded failure classes for missing certificate, invalid certificate, revoked certificate, hostname mismatch, and plaintext attempt
sanitized diagnostics without DSNs, tokens, private keys, certificate bodies, production hostnames, or subject material
traceable failure metadata tied to rollback/fail-closed criteria
rollback owner and rollback plan reference
emergency-disable owner and plan reference
fail-closed status if smoke, failure diagnostics, redaction, or reviewer evidence is missing
operator signoff required before any go/no-go activation state change

redaction_and_secret_hygiene.policy: Evidence packages, docs, status, checker output, and artifacts must contain no plaintext secrets, credential values, token values, private key material, certificate bodies, unredacted connection strings, production host secrets, production hostnames, certificate subjects, full secret paths, or plaintext fallback evidence.
allowed_examples: hashes or immutable image digests without secret material

non_goals: No registry DB mTLS activation, no live activation, and no production activation proof.

No real certificate material, private key material, credential values, provisioning, production host mutation, compose/profile activation, plaintext fallback, runtime behavior change, deployment config change, dependency change, lockfile change, or production-state change.
No acceptance of readiness prerequisites as proof activation occurred.
